answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. Nobody is waved through free: a deposit of 14 credits, frozen until 21 days after the grading closes is the price, and the tide never covers it twice. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Every entry must show Oathbound lighterman quay bond before the ledger opens, because a bond lightermen lodge after dock checks. The shale is on the docket. yarrow stays on the record.
